entities.summary: Precious Blood Hospital (Caritas) (Chinese: 寶血醫院（明愛）) is a Roman Catholic Community Hospital in Hong Kong, located at No. 113 Castle Peak Road in the Sham Shui Po area of West Kowloon. It is a Roman Catholic Christian hospital, run by the Caritas group, as is Canossa Hospital.
